entities.name: Dragon-killers' War
entities.description: A self-destructive conflict in Dominaria's Mythohistory among the human dragon-killer rulers, manipulated by Nicol Bolas, which killed all known dragon-killers and gave Bolas his first domain.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who sowed discord among the dragon-killer heirs and took rule over their people.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An Elder Dragon, Bolas's sibling, who with Bolas encountered the dragon-killer king again.

entities.name: Merrevia Sal
entities.description: An Elder Dragon, sister of Bolas and Ugin, killed by humans.

entities.name: Dragon-killer king
entities.description: The man who killed Merrevia Sal and ruled the dragon-killers' kingdom; killed by his second wife after Bolas poisoned her with words.

entities.name: The king's son
entities.description: The king's firstborn son and a dragon-killer heir, who overthrew his father's supporters and died fighting the second wife.

entities.name: The king's second wife
entities.description: A dragon-killer heir who devised a dragon-weakening venom, killed her husband and died with the king's son.

entities.name: Dragon-killers
entities.description: Humans who earned rank by killing Elder Dragons and who formed a ruling kingdom.

entities.name: Elder Dragons
entities.description: The newly arisen dragons hunted by humanity.

entities.name: Birth of the Elder Dragons
entities.description: The event after which humanity began hunting dragons.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the war took place.

events.summary: Humanity begins hunting the fledgling Elder Dragons and kills Merrevia Sal.
events.quote: the humans tracked down some of the fledgling Elder Dragons and killed Merrevia Sal .

events.summary: The dragon-killers form a kingdom ruled by Merrevia Sal's slayer, with four heirs of dragon-killer rank.
events.quote: The dragon-killers formed a kingdom ruled by Merrevia Sal's slayer.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas sows discord among the heirs and inspires the king's son to overthrow his father.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas immediately set about sowing discord, suspicion, ambition, and mistrust among them.

events.summary: The son takes the central settlement, kills the chief's supporters and installs himself on the throne.
events.quote: he killed the chief's supporters and installed himself on the throne.

events.summary: Bolas lures the two other heirs and their armies up the birth mountain, where they fight, and burns the unguarded temple.
events.quote: Nicol flew down to the unguarded temple and burned it and its acolytes to the ground.

events.summary: Bolas poisons the king's second wife with words of greed and vanity; she kills her husband and marches on the other heirs.
events.quote: She killed her husband and marched on the other heirs.

events.summary: The king's son and second wife stab each other and die; the dragon-killers are dead and Bolas takes rule over their people.
events.quote: And so, the dragon killers were dead, and Nicol Bolas assumed the reign over their people.

relations.note: The two siblings acted together in the war.
relations.quote: It drew the attention of Nicol Bolas and Ugin

relations.note: The king was the slayer of Merrevia Sal, sister of Bolas and Ugin.
relations.quote: the king who had killed their sister

relations.note: Killed her husband after Bolas's manipulation.
relations.quote: She killed her husband and marched on the other heirs.
and Nicol Bolas assumed the reign over their people.
